svg.title: Mutual information discards the sign
svg.desc: Panel a: Gaussian mutual information minus one half log of one minus rho squared is 0.223 nats at both rho equal to plus 0.6 and minus 0.6. Panel b: two sensor pairs, one agreeing and one disagreeing, carry equal mutual information. Signed correlation separates them; mutual information cannot.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: signed correlation separates the pairs; mutual information cannot
sample correlations exact by construction; series are illustrative
